Lemma
[Commutator of covariant and time derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0245, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0246 1. ch13:13.26\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

If $T$ is a covariant $p$-tensor along Ricci flow, then \[ abla ^k\partial _tT-\partial _t abla ^kT \preccurlyeq 3n(p+1)\sum _{i=1}^k rac{(k+1)!}{(i+1)!(k-i)!} abla ^i\Rm * abla ^{k-i}T. \]
Proof

\sketch For $k=1$, variation of the connection gives $( abla \partial _t-\partial _t abla )T=3p abla \Ric *T$. Differentiate inductively. Leibniz’ rule and Pascal’s identity combine adjacent coefficients, while $k+p\leq (p+1)(k+1)$ controls the new boundary term.

□
